p1: After the giant fell, David talked with King Saul. Saul’s son Jonathan, a prince, was there listening.
Jonathan’s heart felt tied to David’s heart. Jonathan loved David as much as he loved himself. The two became best friends.
Then Jonathan and David made a covenant. A covenant is a big, serious promise, like a hug made of words. They made it because they loved each other.
p2: Jonathan took off his own robe and gave it to David. He gave him his sword, his bow, and his belt too. Jonathan gave his very best to his friend.
Jesus calls us His friends too, and He gave His very best for us. Tonight, think of a friend. What could you share with them tomorrow?
old: King Saul’s son Jonathan saw how brave David was. They became best friends right away! Jonathan loved David like a brother.
Jonathan gave David his special royal robe. He gave him his sword and his bow. That was a HUGE gift — Jonathan was the prince!
Even though Jonathan should have been the next king, he didn’t get jealous of David. He helped David and supported him. That’s what real friends do!
God blessed David in everything he did. He won battles. Everyone loved him. But Jonathan was happy for his friend, not jealous. Real friends are happy when good things happen to each other!
